subject.why: Depicts the requested cove with sand, water, wooden jetty, and rock arch.

category.why: Features a grounded foreground band of sand and water with low-angle perspective.

clean.why: Free of text, UI elements, watermarks, and characters.

framing.why: Rocks crop heavily off the left, top, and right edges, lacking required margins.

colour.why: Warm, vibrant sunrise tones with clear separation between elements.

detail.why: Maintains chunky, simplified shapes without excessive micro-textures.

style.why: Matches reference style with smooth satin forms and clean stylized lighting.

fix: Scale down and re-center the rock structure so it has clear margins on the top and sides rather than touching the canvas edges.
